Build passes clean, 0 errors. The rest are harmless deprecation noise from the bump (Node's DEP0142/198/233/250/267 warnings) — not worth chasing.

Two real bugs from the bump, both fixed:
1. `src/core/options.js:6` — read old field name `options.retries` (now `undefined`) instead of the new `options.retryCount`. Fixed to use `retryCount`.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js:7` — new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined`, but the check only handled `true`/`false` and threw otherwise. Added an `undefined` → `false` (disabled) case.

Next: run your actual test suite if you have one — I only verified the build script exits 0.
